purpose: Run the Batch004 broad equal-step four-stage factor grid independently for two pre-2025 active-return objectives relative to the Shanghai Composite price index.

execution.fees_slippage_and_corporate_actions: identical to Batch004; screening uses the verified QFQ execution approximation and each frozen champion receives a raw-price plus corporate-action audit

benchmark.required_identity_evidence: the parquet content or metadata must audibly establish that the series is the Shanghai Composite Index; otherwise stop and request an additional explicit whitelist
benchmark.annual_return_formula: last trading day close of calendar year / last trading day close of prior calendar year - 1
benchmark.required_price_date: a valid final trading close for 2019 is mandatory; stop if absent
benchmark.boundary_alignment: calendar-year boundaries identical to strategy account annual-return reporting
benchmark.comparison_limitation: the benchmark is an ordinary price index excluding dividends, while the audited strategy account includes corporate-action cash dividends

active_return.definition: E_y = strategy account annual return R_y - Shanghai Composite annual price-index return B_y
active_return.std: population standard deviation across 2020-2024 with ddof=0
active_return.variance: std squared, recorded only as a validation field and never used for selection

selection_order_each_phase: annual active return std ddof=0 ascending
candidate_id ascending deterministic stable tie break
annual active return std ddof=0 ascending
candidate_id ascending deterministic stable tie break

independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.name: M_internal_weights
independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.inherit: Batch004 default T and H internal formulas, Batch003 frozen outer M/T/H weights, and daily_top_k=3

independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.name: T_internal_weights
independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.inherit: this objective's phase 1 unique winner plus Batch004 default H, Batch003 frozen outer weights, and daily_top_k=3

independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.name: H_internal_weights
independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.inherit: this objective's phase 1 and phase 2 unique winners plus Batch003 frozen outer weights and daily_top_k=3

independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.name: outer_M_T_H_weights
independent_sequential_grid_per_objectiv.inherit: this objective's three internal unique winners and daily_top_k=3

audit.champions: audit both final champions using pre-2025 raw prices and complete corporate actions; if identical, one execution audit may be reused with explicit disclosure
